study_plan4_qadapt.question: Can a small receiver-side query adjustment improve B's use of the transferred cache when no reference model supplies attention or answers?
study_plan4_qadapt.basis: Adapts Attuner (arXiv 2609.36722, Section 4) to the transferred twelve-carrier cache. Motivated by the fresh-key result (63 -> 94 labels in free generation with transferred values kept). The oracle's 106/108 is reference-guided recovery, not evidence that B reads the transferred values, and is not a basis for expecting a similar repair.
amendments_before_training: Prep check: support token IDs must match within a template; support tensors are reported against the template's first sheet instead of required to be byte-identical (opening positions are re-prefilled per sheet in different-length FP16 forwards). Mismatched R therefore uses each sheet's own support plus the partner's R rather than the partner's whole cache. No training or evaluation had been run.

Training forwards (teacher logits and student) use memory-efficient (sdpa) attention, because eager attention keeps every layer's attention matrix for the backward pass and does not fit on a T4. Generation, selection and evaluation stay on eager attention, as in all earlier runs; kernel agreement is reported by the implementation check. No training had been run.

Targets are the saved teacher plan and answer texts re-tokenized, followed by EOS when the teacher was not truncated; alignment with the teacher's own forced predictions is checked. A sheet's loss is the KL summed over its plan and answer response tokens divided by their total count (plan and answer backpropagate separately); each sheet's loss is divided by 4 within an optimizer step. Dynamic loss scaling starts at 1024 with default growth and backoff; a step skipped for overflow is counted, not repeated.

Before training, a separate implementation check on the first 4 training base sheets (3 optimizer steps) verifies zero-initialised reproduction, gradients on adapter parameters only, finite loss, unchanged received caches, and the absence of the teacher plan from the plan-pass input. Its adapter and optimizer are reset and nothing from it is saved or used for selection.

Base labels of 288: adapted 284, unadapted 181, adapted no-R 141, unadapted no-R 115, adapted partner R 137, fk_fv 284, text 284, full KV 285. Mismatched follows partner 132 vs own 16 of 148; A-change pairs 24/24 vs 8/24. Adapted minus fk_fv / full KV / text: 0 / -1 / 0 labels (intervals span zero). Decode +7.8% per token, prefill +3.9%. No cost advantage over text.
amendments_before_eval: Full KV (A's complete cache rebuilt from its saved token IDs, as in timing12; unadapted) is added as a reference on eval base and a_flip, so the adapted receiver can be compared against reconstruction, full KV and text. Added after the dev gates and before any eval A sheet was written.
The selected checkpoint (epoch 1) is hashed into frozen_candidate.json before eval A sheets are written; every eval row records the hash, and the run refuses a changed checkpoint.

The registered dev gates are recomputed on eval and reported; nothing is selected from them. Paired comparisons use the family-level cluster bootstrap (2000 draws, seed 2026): adapted vs unadapted, fk_fv, full KV, text, and adapted no-R.

Overhead is reported as decode seconds per generated token and prefill seconds, adapted vs unadapted on the same caches, plus resident cache positions per condition. No cost advantage is claimed from reliability.

decision_rule.otherwise: report the limit, with the preparation, prefill and decode differences that explain it
decision_rule.break_even: one-time adapter cost (teacher targets, training state build, training, merge) divided by the per-handoff saving, only if the saving is repeatable
decision_rule.not_claimed: superiority of the communication format: the KV receiver was adapted and the text receiver was not

study_plan4_qmerge.textadapt_diagnostic: the frozen adapter (unmerged) applied to the text receiver on the eval sheets; a negative result would not show what a separately text-trained receiver could achieve

integration_check.why: the first bench version timed GPU-side selection and re-rotation but then fed B the frozen R (built on the CPU when the states were selected) copied host-to-GPU; the R that the timed path produces had not been passed through B
integration_check.sheets: plan4_qadapt_dev (the agree sheets), merged receiver; checkpoint, support, prompts and selection unchanged

runs.frozen_std: frozen R, B's standard two-call path
runs.actual_std: R from A's GPU selection and re-rotation, same standard path (isolates the R difference)
runs.actual_direct: GPU R placed straight into B's cache on the GPU with shared-prefix generation (the same_gpu bench path)

recorded: key max/mean absolute difference and bit-equal fraction per layer
forced logits frozen vs actual R on the frozen_std outputs (max abs, KL, argmax agreement)
labels, all-twelve cases, final choices, formatting, every changed sheet listed
integration_check.tolerance: the agree gates: forced argmax agreement >= 0.99 (actual_std only), at most 1 of 288 labels, 1 all-twelve case and 1 final choice lost, formatting not worse; actual_std and actual_direct are each compared with frozen_std
integration_check.if_passed: the bench feeds B the GPU-prepared R directly
integration_check.if_failed: the bench refuses to run; the difference and its cause (R vs direct path) are documented before any deployment timing is interpreted

deployment.same_gpu: direct reuse on one GPU: R is selected and re-rotated on the GPU and placed straight into B's cache; no copies. Full KV: B takes over A's cache; the per-repetition copy the benchmark needs is timed separately and excluded
deployment.device_transfer: transfer between devices approximated on one T4: device-to-host copy after A's preparation and host-to-device copy before B's (pageable, synchronous); network between hosts not measured; bytes reported
deployment.primary: same_gpu; device_transfer is optional and reported separately
deployment.earlier_bench_files: bench_evaluations.jsonl / bench_summary.json from the first version (GPU preparation plus host-to-GPU copy of the frozen R) match neither deployment and are not used for deployment conclusions

dependencies_critical.reason: upstream KV relay uses DynamicCache key_cache/value_cache; transformers 4.58+ breaks it
